## 主张 Claim

编码后的任意有限二叉接合树得到代码 c，当且仅当原来指定叶子的同一树可在 J 中实现并得到编码为 c 的结果。 / An encoded finite binary joining tree realizes code c exactly when the same tree with its originally specified leaves has a J realization whose result encodes to c.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 同一部分接合 J；每对输入具有有限结果集合。 / One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.
